name: Parameters
description: Create custom configuration with arbitrary properties, defined as typed parameter plugins inside exportable collection config entities and read via tokens, Twig or a PHP API.

suggests.drupal/token: Provides a token browser for conveniently browsing the parameter tokens this module generates.

project_description: Parameters is a "Config Construction Kit": it lets you define named, typed configuration values without writing a settings form, a route or a config-schema entry of your own. Each value is a Parameter plugin (raw string, integer, float, boolean, date/time, formatted text, options, color, machine name, icon SVG, encrypted secret, nested YAML, HTTP endpoint, auto-incrementing integer, referenced parameter, and selections of entity types/bundles/fields/user roles). Parameters live inside `parameters_collection` config entities: a single `global` collection plus one collection per fieldable entity bundle (e.g. `node.article`). Collections export and import through standard configuration management and provide config schema for every value type. Values are read contextually through automatically generated Tokens (`[parameter:global:name]`, `[node:parameter:name]`), a Twig `p()` function, ECA, or the `Drupal\parameters\Parameter` PHP helper (`Parameter::get()` / `Parameter::value()`). Collections auto-lock the first time a parameter is read, guaranteeing availability by preventing deletion until explicitly unlocked. The optional `parameters_ui` submodule adds the web UI (a "Manage parameters" tab alongside Field UI) and all permissions; `parameters_content` (deprecated) adds a content-entity-backed parameter type.
